sections.title: 2. Selected Data Protection Methods Used by the Operator

items.text: Login areas and fields for entering personal data are protected at the transmission layer (SSL certificate). This ensures that personal data and login information entered on the website are encrypted on the user's computer and can only be read on the destination server.
The Website is hosted (technically maintained) on the operator's server: cyberFolks.pl
The hosting company maintains logs at the server level to ensure technical reliability. The following information may be recorded:
subItems: resources identified by URL (addresses of requested resources – pages, files)
client workstation name – identification carried out via the HTTP protocol
information about errors that occurred during the execution of HTTP transactions
URL of the previously visited page by the user (referrer link) – if access to the Website occurred via a link
diagnostic information related to the process of self-ordering services through online registrars on the site
information related to handling emails sent to or from the Operator

sections.title: 4. Your Rights and Additional Information on Data Usage

items.text: Your personal data is processed by the Controller no longer than necessary to perform activities related to it as required by separate regulations (e.g., accounting). For marketing data, processing will not exceed 3 years.
You have the right to request from the Controller:

You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data for the purpose of pursuing the legitimate interests of the Controller, including profiling, provided that the right to object cannot be exercised if there are legally justified grounds for processing that override your interests, rights, and freedoms, in particular for the establishment, pursuit, or defense of claims.
You may file a complaint regarding the Controller’s actions with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw.
Providing personal data is voluntary, but necessary for the operation of the Website.

Actions involving automated decision-making, including profiling, may be taken with respect to you to provide services under the concluded agreement and for the Controller’s direct marketing purposes.
Personal data may be transferred to third countries within the meaning of data protection regulations, which means they may be sent outside the European Union.
The Website collects information voluntarily provided by the user, including personal data, if submitted.
The Website may record information about connection parameters, in particular the timestamp and IP address.

In some cases, the Website may store information that facilitates linking data submitted in a form with the email address of the user completing the form. In such cases, the user's email address may appear within the URL of the page containing the form.

Data submitted in the form is processed for purposes resulting from the specific function of the form, in particular for handling service requests, commercial contact, service registration, or other actions described in the context of the given form. Each form description clearly informs the user of its purpose.
Information about users’ behavior on the Website may be logged.
These data are used solely for the purpose of administering the Website and ensuring its proper functioning.
The Controller may use marketing techniques in accordance with applicable law, in particular for direct marketing, only with respect to users who have given their appropriate consent.
The Website uses cookies.

Cookies are computer data, in particular text files, which are stored on the end device of the Website User and are intended for use on the Website's pages. Cookies usually contain the name of the website they come from, the time they are stored on the end device, and a unique number.
The entity placing cookies on the end device of the Website User and accessing them is the Website operator.
Cookies are used for the following purposes:
subItems: maintaining the user's session on the Website (after logging in), allowing the user not to re-enter the login and password on each subpage of the Website
carrying out the purposes described above in the section 'Relevant Marketing Techniques'

items.text: Two main types of cookies are used on the Website: 'session' cookies and 'persistent' cookies. 'Session' cookies are temporary files stored on the User's device until logging out, leaving the website, or closing the browser. 'Persistent' cookies are stored on the User's device for the time specified in the cookie parameters or until they are deleted by the User.

Web browsing software (web browser) usually allows cookies to be stored on the User's device by default. Website Users can change these settings. The browser allows cookies to be deleted or automatically blocked. Detailed information on this can be found in the browser's help or documentation.
Restrictions on the use of cookies may affect some functionalities available on the Website's pages.

Cookies placed on the User's end device may also be used by entities cooperating with the Website operator, in particular by companies such as Google (Google Inc., USA), Facebook (Facebook Inc., USA), and Twitter (Twitter Inc., USA).
